{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2024}} {{Infobox award | name = 2014 FIFA Ballon d'Or | subheader = | image = Cristiano Ronaldo - Ballon d'Or (cropped).jpg | image_size = | alt = | caption = 2014 FIFA Ballon d'Or winner, Cristiano Ronaldo | awarded_for = | date = {{start date|2015|01|12|df=y}} | location = [[Zürich]], Switzerland | country = Switzerland | presenter = FIFA | host = | former name = | preshow_host = | acts = | website = {{URL|ballondor.com}} | runtime = | award1_type = Won by | award1_winner= {{flagicon|POR}} [[Cristiano Ronaldo]] (3rd [[Ballon d'Or]]) | previous = [[2013 FIFA Ballon d'Or|2013]] | main = [[FIFA Ballon d'Or]] | next = [[2015 FIFA Ballon d'Or|2015]] }} The '''2014 [[FIFA Ballon d'Or]]''' ({{lit|'''2014 FIFA Golden Ball'''}}), was the fifth year for FIFA's awards for the top football players and coaches of the year. The awards were given out in Zürich on 12 January 2015. Real Madrid and Portugal forward [[Cristiano Ronaldo]] won the FIFA Ballon d'Or as the World Player of the Year for a second consecutive time, having won it previously [[2013 FIFA Ballon d'Or|last year]].{{cite web |url=https://www.fifa.com/ballon-dor/player-of-the-year/index.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140925231456/http://www.fifa.com/ballon-dor/player-of-the-year/index.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=25 September 2014 |title=FIFA Ballon d'Or |work=FIFA.com |publisher=[[FIFA|Fédération Internationale de Football Association]] |date=12 January 2015 |access-date=13 January 2015}} This was his third [[Ballon d'Or]] win overall, placing him second to only [[Lionel Messi]] for the most wins in the history of the award. [[Nadine Keßler]] was named as the Women's World Player of the Year, while [[Joachim Löw]] received the World Coach of the Year for Men's Football and [[Ralf Kellermann]] the World Coach of the Year for Women's Football.{{cite news |title=Cristiano Ronaldo beats Lionel Messi and Manuel Neuer to Ballon d'Or award – as it happened |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2015/jan/12/ballon-dor-cristiano-ronaldo-v-lionel-messi-v-manuel-neuer-live |work=[[The Guardian]] |date=12 January 2015 |access-date=13 January 2015 |archive-date=21 June 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230621011153/https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2015/jan/12/ballon-dor-cristiano-ronaldo-v-lionel-messi-v-manuel-neuer-live |url-status=live }} The ceremony was hosted by [[Kate Abdo]].{{cite news |title=Kate Abdo, your co-host for this evening's FIFA gala |url=http://as.com/diarioas/2015/01/12/english/1421068016_385860.html |work=[[Diario AS|AS]] |date=12 January 2015 |access-date=13 January 2015 |archive-date=13 January 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150113043824/http://as.com/diarioas/2015/01/12/english/1421068016_385860.html |url-status=dead }} ==Winners and nominees== In late October 2014, the FIFA revealed shortlists for the FIFA Ballon d'Or, FIFA Women's World Player of the Year, and FIFA World Coaches of the Year. The shortlists for the women's awards were revealed on 24 October, and the men's shortlists were revealed on 28 October. ===FIFA Ballon d'Or=== {{multiple image | align = right | direction = vertical | header = | width1 = 165 | image1 = Cristiano Ronaldo - Ballon d'Or (cropped).jpg|thumb | alt1 = | caption1 = [[Cristiano Ronaldo]] presenting his second FIFA Ballon d'Or to fans at the [[Santiago Bernabéu Stadium|Santiago Bernabéu]] in January 2015 | width2 = 165 | image2 = Leo Messi v Almeria 020314 (extra crop).jpg|thumb | alt2 = | caption2 = [[Lionel Messi]] | width3 = 165 | image3 = Manuel Neuer 2012 (cropped).jpg|thumb | alt3 = | caption3 = [[Manuel Neuer]] }} The results for the 2014 FIFA Ballon d'Or were:{{cite news|title=FIFA Ballon d'Or 2014 – voting results |url=http://resources.fifa.com/mm/document/ballon-dor/general/02/50/58/59/fboaward_rankingpresslist2014_neutral.pdf |work=FIFA.com |publisher=Fédération Internationale de Football Association |date=12 January 2015 |access-date=12 January 2015 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150112225935/http://resources.fifa.com/mm/document/ballon-dor/general/02/50/58/59/fboaward_rankingpresslist2014_neutral.pdf |archive-date=12 January 2015 }} {| class="wikitable" !
